states.head_localizer: frozen_head_probe._isolated_model(tr, "p_last_hinge", head["state"]); head["state"] keys must equal {2.weight, 2.bias}
frozen_head_probe._isolated_model(tr, "p_last_hinge", head["state"]); head["state"] keys must equal {2.weight, 2.bias}

grid.population_description: all canonical real words, full and untruncated

sd_normalization.SD_DEFINITION: torch.Tensor.std() of the flattened, pooled intact activations at the site; the 'std' column, NOT 'rms'
sd_normalization.SD_AXES: all axes pooled (batch pooled with hidden); no dim= argument; unitwise statistics not retained
sd_normalization.SD_POPULATION: deterministic_sample(range(len(entries)), n=2048, seed=7), returned sorted (ascending entry index), batch_size=256, one teacher-forced model(enc_in, enc_mask, dec_in) per batch
sd_normalization.SD_TENSOR_SHAPE: scalar — one float per (state, route); isotropic across hidden units
sd_normalization.ZERO_SD_BEHAVIOR: no special-casing; scale 0 yields amplitude 0, an exactly zero perturbation and no registered hook; draw short-circuits at amplitude == 0.0; no floor, no clamp, no exception

noise.item_id_definition: canonical word string; unique across the population; stable under reordering
noise.derivation: sha256(b'GXLR-eps-v1|' + canonical_json(payload)) -> sha256 counter-mode byte stream -> big-endian uint32 -> x = u / 2**32 in [0,1) -> epsilon = 2x - 1
noise.nesting_tolerance_justification: lambda in {0.25,0.50,1.00} are exact binary powers of two; scaling by a power of two is exact in IEEE-754 and commutes with round-to-nearest
noise.ltm_mode_guard: refuse ltm_encoder_state unless ltm_encoder_mode == 'unigru_last_hidden' (slot 1 is discarded under bigru_masked_mean)

paired_test.test: exact McNemar (two-sided exact binomial on discordant pairs)

not_inert.criterion: n_items_changed_vs_intact > 0 in at least one of {NATIVE, FIXED05, wm_only, ltm_only}

not_saturated.criterion: the route family retains non-degenerate output

seed_aggregation.rule: a (state, route, lambda, convention) cell is diagnostically valid iff at least 3 of its 4 lesion seeds are valid

diagnostic_validity.reporting: ALL diagnostically valid severities MUST be reported; none may be suppressed

robustness.rule: an effect at a (state, route, lambda, convention) cell is ROBUST iff at least 3 of 4 lesion seeds have p_exact_mcnemar < 0.05 with the SAME sign of net_change_in_correct, AND the seed-pooled exact McNemar is significant at 0.05 with that same sign
robustness.otherwise: the cell's effect is NOT_ROBUST and contributes no sign

outcome_classification.stage_independence: CANONICAL and FREE_AR are classified independently; neither may adjudicate, override or filter the other

letters.D: robust null — no reliable NATIVE/FIXED05 difference
letters.F_HETEROGENEOUS: diagnostically valid severities disagree in sign

outcome_classification.heterogeneity_veto: A, B or D may NOT be declared for a route family / convention if another diagnostically valid severity in that same route family shows a robust opposite-signed NATIVE-vs-FIXED05 effect; such a case is OUTCOME_F_HETEROGENEOUS. The veto is checked BEFORE any letter is emitted and strictly dominates.
outcome_classification.joint_rule: if the CANONICAL and FREE_AR letters for a route family differ, JOINT_OUTCOME = F_HETEROGENEOUS and both stage letters are reported alongside it
outcome_classification.no_retrospective_promotion: no severity may be promoted retrospectively as 'the lesion result'; the reported unit is the SET of diagnostically valid severities and their signs
outcome_classification.severity_selection: no severity may be added, dropped or reweighted on the basis of NATIVE-vs-FIXED05 behaviour

prohibitions: no change to gate architecture, alpha, gate_threshold, or the fixed05 definition
no severity chosen or dropped by NATIVE-vs-FIXED05 behaviour
no contact with V7 / Phase 9 scientific state
